targets.old_statement: West Virginia law requires every motorist on the state's public roads to carry motor vehicle liability insurance with minimum coverage of twenty-five thousand dollars for one death or injury, fifty thousand dollars for two deaths or injuries, and twenty-five thousand dollars for property damage.
